About Us

We are Africa’s leading provider of integrated renewable energy and sustainable solutions, delivering end-to-end services across Solar, Battery Energy Storage, Hybrid Systems, Waste-To-Energy projects, and Transmission & Distribution infrastructure. Serving commercial, industrial, utility-scale, and community clients, we combine technical expertise, innovative design, and project execution excellence to deliver reliable, efficient, and environmentally responsible energy solutions.
